prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Texture-source surface painting of the exact existing Kreegan forward outpost 3D model. Output exactly 1024 x 1024 PNG with real transparent background, unresized.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry authority: the grey orthographic guide. Preserve its exact alpha silhouette, every outline, opening, internal shape edge, position and scale pixel-for-pixel. Paint only its existing surfaces. Do not rotate, change camera, recompose, crop, move, add or remove geometry. Inputs 2 and 3 are appearance references only: design_reference.png is the approved material and colour authority; concept_crop.png is the original concept. Never import their perspective, silhouette or lighting.
Paint chipped ivory-white ceramic panels with aged gold bands, black-violet resin/chitin wrapping the structure with vivid orange veins/sacs in its seams, rusty scaffold, black glass rubble, and the existing banner as worn dark red cloth with its reference white motif. Preserve every scaffold beam, rope, spike, doorway and hole exactly where the guide places it.
LIGHTING: This is albedo for texture projection, NOT a beauty render. Flat even shadowless viewer-facing light on all surfaces. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no directional shading or recess darkening, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. The dark resin is its inherent black-violet colour, without white shiny streaks. Orange glowing seams are painted orange only; no light spill or bloom on surrounding materials. No background, no floor, no labels. Preserve guide transparency including all openings and small detached fragments.
VIEW: FRONT. Paint directly over guide_front.png, maintaining the exact straight-on orthographic projection and all its geometric boundaries.
reason: Correction needed: raw return is 1254 x 1254 instead of 1024 x 1024; visible geometry drift and residual shading/highlights.
